enabled.description: Enable the earlyoom service. When disabled, earlyoom will not run at boot.

memory_min_percent.description: Memory low threshold percentage. When free memory drops below this percentage of total RAM, earlyoom starts killing processes.

swap_min_percent.description: Swap low threshold percentage. When free swap drops below this percentage of total swap, earlyoom becomes more aggressive (prefers killing memory hogs).

memory_min_kb.description: Absolute minimum free memory threshold in kilobytes. If free memory falls below this, earlyoom acts regardless of percentage thresholds.

prefer_mem_usage.description: If true, prefer killing processes that use more memory (larger RSS). If false, prioritize killing processes with less OOM score adjustment (more protected).

prefer_oom_score_adj.description: If true, prefer killing processes with more negative OOM score adjustments (i.e., more protected). Only effective when prefer_mem_usage is false.

ignore_patterns.description: List of command-line substrings. Processes whose full command line contains any of these strings will be skipped by earlyoom.

cli_args.description: Options to pass to earlyoom. Defaults to '-r 3600' which reports memory status every hour.
